classificationRules.ALIS_UNDERCONVERGED: The reference is internally stable, ALIS shows a material shift, and the fresh cross-method comparison materially improves relative to the failed baseline.
classificationRules.BOTH_CONVERGE_AND_AGREE: Both methods satisfy internal-stability gates and the fresh high-history cross-method comparison satisfies all agreement gates.
classificationRules.INCONCLUSIVE: No earlier mutually exclusive rule applies; sampling or directional evidence remains insufficient.
classificationRules.PERSISTENT_METHOD_DISCREPANCY: Both methods satisfy internal-stability gates but the fresh high-history cross-method comparison fails at least one agreement gate.
classificationRules.REFERENCE_UNDERCONVERGED: ALIS is internally stable, the reference shows a material shift, and the fresh cross-method comparison materially improves relative to the failed baseline.
classificationRules.STRUCTURAL_OR_EXECUTION_FAILURE: Any authorization, input, execution, output, manifest, hash, or analysis invariant fails.
